title: NLO - Deslime and Mill Cyclone Valve Change

fields.why: The proposed operations change is to replace the manual valves on the deslime and mill cyclone cluster to pneumatic actuated valves. Changing to all pneumatic actuated valves allows NLO to fully automate cyclones to open and close for future control philosophy changes (e.g. switching from pressure to density cyclone control). Cyclones will be able to switch on/off to maintain stability and constant feed density through the flotation circuit. It also allows the ability to track all cyclone run hours leading to preventative maintenance scheduling.
fields.design:
As part of the OCM, the following manual valves will need to added into CITECT as they will be pneumatic actuated valves:
- 410-XV-1245D
- 410-XV-1245F
- 410-XV-1245E
- 410-XV-1280D
- 410-XV-1280E

fields.impact: CROs will be able to open/close these cyclone valves from CITECT instead of manually in the field.
